batting.dismissal: c TH David b HH Pandya

batting.name: TM Head
batting.dismissal: c Naman Dhir b G Coetzee

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Naman Dhir b PP Chawla

batting.dismissal: c Abhishek Sharma b PJ Cummins

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b Shahbaz Ahmed

batting.name: Naman Dhir
batting.dismissal: c PJ Cummins b JD Unadkat

batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b PJ Cummins

balls.text: full outside off once again. Klaasen digs it out towards long-off and Markram sprints back for the second
full and wide. Mistimes back towards the bowler
full on the stumps and Klaasen gives it his all. Didn't middle it but enough to just clear the long-on

And they go past the record. A full toss on the pads. Klaasen fails to middle it and for a moment, it looked like the deep midwicket was in with a chance. But he was slightly inside the boundary line and fails to get a hand on it
full and outside off. Klaasen smashes it over the non-striker's end. This is now the joint-highest total in the IPL
in the blockhole. Digs it out towards deep midwicket
full and wide once more. Markram lets it go. Another wide. This time Mumbai review it, and it stays a wide
A full toss but way outside off. Markram leaves it alone. Mumbai have reviewed the wide call. And it stays a wide. Oh, wait. Looks like SRH reviewed it thinking it might be a no-ball
a low full toss. Klaasen works it towards deep midwicket for a couple
a slower one, on the fuller side. And hits cuts it to the right of extra cover for another boundary. The leather has come off the ball! The fourth umpire runs in with a box of replacement balls
a low full toss at the stumps but Klaasen stays low and hits it over the non-striker for four. 250 comes up as well
a slower one outside off. On the fuller side of good length. Klaasen fails to connect
an excellent yorker. Markram does well to get is bat on it and pick up a single
Bumrah gets it wrong. Way, way outside off. Proves he is human
almost a yorker. Klaasen hits it towards long-on
full on the stumps. Klaasen creates room and works it towards long-off
a quicker yorker. Klaasen works it towards square leg and comes back for the second. Brings up his fifty off 23 balls - the slowest of the three for SRH tonight!
a slower yorker. Markram works it towards deep midwicket
a full toss on the pads. Flicked towards deep midwicket
cramps the batter with a length ball. Defended
full on the stumps. Which means it's in the slot for Klaasen, who launches it over long-on
a reverse lap. Full and straight and Markram just helps it over short third
full and Klaasen slices it over extra cover for one
full and wide and Klaasen cannot connect. And it's been given a wide
in the slot and Klaasen corrects his mistake. Last time it was only a four, this is an 89-metres monster
full and wide. Klaasen was looking to steer it fine but fails to connect
full around off and Klaasen just muscles it over the bowler's head. Long-on had no chance. Klaasen's first four this IPL, after 11 sixes
a low full toss. Driven to deep extra cover
A wide. Full but way outside off
length ball angling down the leg side. Markram was looking to give himself some room. Pulls it behind square leg
almost a yorker, angling in towards the pads. Flicked uppishly behind square leg
in the blockhole. Digs it out towards mid-off
full but way down the leg side. Kishan dives across but cannot get there. Five wides
short and down the leg side. Klaasen misses out. Fails to middle the pull and gets only a single to long leg
a slower one on the stumps. Klaasen turns it towards midwicket and comes back for the second
A low full toss. Pushed to long-off
full and angling in. Flicked towards deep midwicket
a slower one. Length outside off. Worked towards wide long-off for one
a bouncer, outside off. But Klaasen shows what sort of form he is in. Just swivels and pulls it over deep square leg. And that brings up 200 for SRH as well
this is superb from Bumrah. Nails the yorker. Markram jams his bat at it and picks up a single to mid-on
another slower one. Length outside off. Mistimed towards long-off for one
124.6kph. A slower one. Full and wide. Markram jams his bat at it to steer it towards deep point
a slower bouncer. Pulled down towards deep midwicket
short around off. Pulled down towards deep midwicket
a full toss on the pads and Klaasen whips it over long leg - into the stands
short of length outside off. Was a slower one as well. Mistimes the cut towards extra cover and punches the bat in frustration
length ball on the pads. Tucked away in front of square leg
length outside off. Cuts it past point for a couple
another full toss. Pushed towards long-off
another slower ball. Klaasen opens the face of the bat to work it towards backward point
a slower length ball. Markram was looking to hit it through the off side but the ball comes in and hits the inside half of the bat. A single to mid-on
Markram fails to put away the free hit. Was a full toss, angling onto the pads but Markram fails to connect
a full toss. Klaasen isn't happy as he can only bunt it down towards long-on. But wait, it's a front-foot no-ball - the siren goes up
a yorker. Digs it out towards midwicket
a slower length ball around off. Pushed towards extra cover where Rohit dives to his right and deflects the ball towards mid-off
length ball angling towards the batter. Punched to long-on
too full around off and middle. Klaasen clears his front leg and launches it over long-off for a six
length ball around off. Punched towards sweeper cover for one
length outside off. Goes back and cuts it towards deep point
much slower through the air. Some turn as well, Markram waits and works it towards mid-on
length outside off. Goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a couple

Chawla finally provides a breakthrough. This was bowled at 112.8kph. Abhishek went for another six but was a bit hurried. As a result, he doesn't get the timing right and Dhir settles under it at deep midwicket
Abhishek looks for a repeat but fails to middle it this time. It goes along the ground towards deep midwicket where Dhir dives to his right to make the stop
short from Chawla. Abhishek doesn't even go on the back foot and launches it over long-on

a length ball around off. Cuts it towards deep point and runs back for the second. The throw is a bit wide. Kishan collects it and back-flicks it in an attempt to hit the stumps. Misses and SRH picks up an overthrow
down the track but Chawla slips in a googly, away from the batter. Abhishek pushes it towards deep extra cover
a full toss on the stumps. Driven towards long-off for one

in the blockhole. Abhishek digs it out on the off side and takes off for a single. But Maphaka is quick to the ball, forcing Abhishek to dive back into his crease even though the bowler never released the ball
full and wide outside off. Abhishek leaves it alone thinking it might be a wide. But the umpire thinks otherwise
a low full toss. Think Maphaka tried a yorker there. But Abhishek is timing them so well, that a desperate dive from long-on was not good enough
a 16-ball fifty. Another slower ball, but a touch too full. Abhishek clatters it into the sightscreen - his sixth six
a slower short ball. This is not a bouncer. Abhishek pulls it over deep midwicket. He is on 44 off just 15
an excellent yorker but nothing is going Mumbai's way. Abhishek just manages to get his bat down, gets an inside edge through his legs, and it beats a diving short third
short and outside off. Markram just stands tall and pulls it over deep midwicket. His first six
a bouncer. Pulled down to deep-backward square leg
length ball around off. Held just a bit in the pitch. Markram was a touch early into his punch but it's safe. Gets a single through covers
a slower length ball in the channel. Markram goes for the cut and gets beaten
length ball outside off. Punched through extra cover, and they sprint back for the second
length ball cramping the batter. Abhishek moves towards the leg side and opens the face of the bat to pick a single to point
and he gets off the mark with a boundary. Short of length outside off, Markram gets on his toes, and on the top of the bounce, and punches it behind point for four
Plan B has worked. Coetzee bowls a length ball but more importantly keeps it away from Head who had to reach out for it. Ends up hitting it to deep-backward point where Dhir pouches it
full on the stumps. Flicked towards deep midwicket
short and wide. Was a slower one. Abhishek makes some room and smashes it through extra cover for four more
a bouncer. Abhishek ducks under but it's too high for Kishan. More freebies for SRH - four byes this time

going full and wide seems to be the new plan. Head looks to steer it fine but fails to middle it. The ball goes to Kishan on the bounce. And for some reason, Kishan has a shy at the stumps - Head wasn't taking a run - and concedes an overthrow
full but way, way outside off
100 comes up for SRH! In just seven overs. Another short googly. Abhishek doesn't mind that. Rocks back and pulls it over long-on
short and down the leg side and Abhishek is not going to miss it out. Goes back and pulls it over deep square leg for the second six of the over
length outside off. Goes back and cuts it towards deep extra cover
down the ground but it's another googly. Abhishek was beaten in the flight but does well to push it through covers for one
a looked like a googly but it's too short, allowing Abhishek to go back and pull it over long-on for a six
a length ball at the stumps. Forced on the off side off the back foot for one
angling in. Head hits it to the left of deep midwicket
There's no stopping Head - 69 metres. Was a slower bouncer and Head pulls it over deep midwicket. Just out of the reach of a leaping Tilak Varma
even better. Scrambled seam, full on the stumps. Head once again gives himself some room and, bends hi back leg and smashes it wide of mid-off. Brings up his fifty as well, off 18 balls
full on the stumps. Think that's the plan against Head but it's not working at the moment. Head moves slightly towards the leg side, clears his front foot and goes over wide mid-on for four
length ball around off. Worked towards point for one
short around off and Abhishek pulls it over long leg for a six. Easy-peasy

starts with a high full toss that was way, way outside off. Called a no-ball for height. Hardik is arguing with the umpire that it should have been a wide. The umpire doesn't agree, and Mumbai have taken a review. The TV umpire confirms it's over the waist height. For Abhishek, that's 1.02 metres. The ball was 1.44 metres high
length ball on the stumps. Was an offcutter, which helped Head who was creating room. Hits it through extra cover for four
a full toss and around off and Head slashes it to the right of the diving point fielder. Hardik has his hands on the head
Hardik goes short, once again targeting the batter. It looks like Head was first thinking of leaving it but then realised it was a slower bouncer and changed his mind. Helped it over short third
Hardik making sure there's no room to work with. Head pushes this length ball towards mid-off
length ball at the batter who was looking to give himself some room. In the end, he is a bit cramped and pushes it towards mid-off
David makes no mistake this time. Hardik goes short, just outside off. Agarwal goes for the pull but ends up top-edging it towards mid-on. A much simpler catch this time for David
just misses the yorker. Agarwal works it towards mid-on for a single
another slower one, 119kph. Length ball around off. Agarwal comes forward but had to adjust to the lack of pace. Defended on the off side
length outside off. Gives himself some room and opens the face of the bat to work it behind point. And they sprint back for the second
a yorker. Head gets his bat down and works it in front of square leg for one
a slower one - that's where the experience comes handy. Head was looking to smash it over mid-on but was way early into the shot. Gets beaten
length ball angling in. Agarwal drops it on the off side and gets to the other end
a short ball, angling in to cramp Head. But he just opens the face of the bat to ramp it over short third. That makes it 22 from the over
too full on the stumps, and Head drills down the ground. The ball was past Maphaka before he could bring his hand down
142.8kph. A similar delivery and an even better response from Head. Swivels to pull into the stands. This one has gone 98 metre
142.9kph. A length ball, Head creates room and launches it over midwicket, all the way for a six. 78 metres
length outside off. Cuts it towards deep-backward point where Mulani cuts it off
length ball angling into the pads. Head was leg side of the ball and fails to connect the flick. Picks up a leg bye
length ball on the pads. Tucked away towards short midwicket
length ball outside off. Head stays leg side of the ball and pushes it through covers where a diving stop keeps it to one
length outside off. Cuts it behind point for one
Pandya goes short. Agarwal makes room, pulls it through midwicket for the second four of the over
length ball on the pads. Tucked away towards square leg
dropped by Tim David. Full around off and Head goes aerial. Doesn't get the elevation. It's to David's left, just below the head height and bursts through his hands for four
length ball on the pads. Agarwal jumps and flicks it towards short midwicket
goes for the yorker again. Head digs it out towards mid-off
141.3kph. A length ball around off. Head transfers the weight on the back foot and smashes it through the gap between cover and extra cover
141.4kph. Almost a yorker, hits the Agarwal on the front pad but the impact was outside the line of leg stump. SRH collect a leg-bye
143kph. A length ball angling across. Agarwal hops and defends
141.7kph. Length ball in the line of the stumps. A bit of shape back. Defended
and he starts with a wide. Goes for but it swings down the leg side. Mayank goes for the flick but fails to connect
Legbreak on a length again, Shepherd can't connect and SRH have their first win of the season!
On a length outside off, punched out through cover point for another boundary
Full outside off, Shepherd moves across the stumps and smacks it down the ground for a boundary
Legbreak tossed up outside off, Shepherd can't connect
Length ball outside off, Shepherd frees his arm and deposits over long-on. Most sixes in a T20 game!
On a length outside off, punched wide of long-off for just a single
Short again, pulled out to deep square leg
Cummins sticks to the short ball plan. Digs it in short outside off, David skies it but it lands safe around midwicket
Slower bouncer outside off, he goes to pull but is beaten on height
Short outside off, David manages to pull it away to deep backward square off an inside edge
Slower bouncer from Cummins and Shepherd can only help it out to deep square leg
Cummins starts off short outside off, David swings it away on the bounce to deep midwicket. That was at 120kph

And Hardik Pandya has to go! Unadkat is all laughs. SRH know they now all but have it in the bag. Cutter dug into the pitch, seaming away. Hardik goes for a pull but can only top edge it. Easy peasy lemon squeezy for Heinrich Klaasen
Slower short ball just outside off, David dabs it to backward point
Nails it and send it into the second tier! Length ball angled into David and he swings it away majestically
Length ball, but way wide of off. Umpire has his arms up

What a fielding effort! Bouncer outside off and Hardik slaps it wide of long-on. Mayank races across to his right and grabs it head height and throws it back in before falling over backwards. He also seems to have hurt himself. The check shows Mayank got rid of the ball before his feet touched the ground. Excellent, excellent fielding
Nails the yorker just outside off, David can only dig it out to extra cover
Full and wide, David extends is arms to reach it and slaps it down along the ground. Long-on and long-off didn't stand a chance
Bhuvneshwar closes out the over with a yorker on off that David can just dig out towards mid-off
Swatted away over extra cover! Bhuvi digs it into the pitch outside off, David plays it almost like a tennis forehand shot. Goes all the way
Bouncer outside off, David goes for the pull but gets a top edge over the keeper and four. Lucky runs for MI, but they won't complain
Low full toss and David doesn't miss out! Flicks it away over deep square leg for his first six today
Back of a length outside off, pulled away to deep midwicket for a couple
Just short of long-on. Yorker-length on off, Hardik jams his bat down and it goes in the air flat, but falls just short of Markram
Slower bouncer outside off, Hardik pulls it and it goes high in the air but falls short of deep midwicket
Full and wide again, David can only get it off the toe end to deep midwicket
Full and wide, David throws his bat at it but misses. Called wide, but SRH review. The umpire's decision is upheld
Unadkat bowls a legcutter back of a leng outside off. David had moved his bat out of the way but attempted to swat it away very late. Can't get it past the keeper
Length ball outside off, Hardik can only slap it down the ground to long-off. The pace-off strategy has been working wonders for SRH
Full outside off, he swings it away to deep square leg off the inside half of the bat
Unadkat takes the pace off as he bowls it wide of off. David can only get an underedge onto the ground
Slower ball on the shorter side of good length away, David can only work it away to deep square
Cummins with another slower one dug in short outside off. Hardik can only get it away towards deep midwicket
Nails the yorker! Hardik can only dig it back out to Cummins
Slower ball, back of length outside off. Seams in towards David who pulls it out to deep square leg
Full on leg, clipped to midwicket

And Cummins gets the well set Tilak! Slower bouncer angled across Tilak. He tried to fetch it from well outside off with a pull and miscues it. Mayank Agarwal comes in from deep midwicket and holds on!
Tilak skips down the track and drills it out to long-on
On a length just outside off, he rocks back and slaps it away to long-off
On a length and wide of off, Tilak slaps it away straight of sweeper cover. Just a single
On a length around leg, eased out through midwicket for two
Inside out and all the way! Tilak skips down the ground to a full delivery tossed up around off and lofts this just past the boundary rope
Hardik goes after a short and wide delivery  outside off. The ball goes in the air but falls short of deep cover
Yorker around leg, Hardik digs it out to the off side. That makes it 11 balls without a boundary
Length ball angled across Tilak, who slaps it away to the sweeper on the off side
Slower ball on a length around off, clipped away through midwicket
Low full toss, drilled past the bowler. Long-off makes the stop
Bhuvneshwar gets the yorker on middle and off, dug back out to the bowler
Hardik looks to give charge to a length ball around off, can only parry it back to the bowler
On a length, wide of off. Hardik slaps it away over cover but can't beat the fielder in the deep
Length ball pulled out to deep midwicket
Tossed up on a length wide of off, Tilak looks to chase it but the ball gets through to the keeper
Googly on a length on leg, Tilak pushes it out to cover
On a length outside off, Hardik slaps it hard but can't get it past Cummins at cover, who throws himself at the ball
And now he goes down the ground! Googly outside off lets him free his arms and pummel it straight down. Bounces just before the boundary, so this will be four
Into the second tier! This is tossed up on off, Hardik leans into it and swings it over cow corner. That's equalled the record for most sixes in an IPL match!
Length ball around off, punched out to long-on. Hardik gets going
Full outside off, Hardik eases a drive to cover

And there is the breakthrough! Slapped straight to cover! On a length around middle and off, Naman makes room and looks to get it over cover. Can't get the elevation and captain Cummins grabs it above head height
Cleverly played! Full and wide, Naman responds by moving completely across the stumps and opening the face to steer it in the gap behind backward point
Full outside off, slower ball, tucked away towards deep midwicket

Unadkat pitches it up wide of off, Tilak gets down on one knee and drives it over cover. A couple of bounces and that's four. Tilak celebrates his fifty with a gesture to the dugout that says "It's fine, I am here"
ON a length outside off, Tilak whips it out to wide long-on
This is some hitting! Full around off and Tilak slogs it away over midwicket.
Length ball on middle, flatter and quicker, drilled out between deep midwicket and long-on
Reverse-swept for six! This was premeditated. It's a length ball on the stumps and he gets it high and handsome over deep third. Looked like a top edge, but he clears the rope comfortably
Strays in line and length and Tilak punishes him! This is a length ball down leg, Tilak gets down on one knee and scoops it over fine leg
Flings it full and wide, Naman lofts it back over the bowler' head out to long-off
Naman comes down the track, Cummins pull his length back and the batter adjusts to help it out to deep midwicket
Yorker attempted on middle, Naman flicks it away past a diving midwicket fielder. MI get two
Class shot! Cummins with another slower ball dug in short. Naman waits for it and flick-pulls it very fine down the leg side and the ball lands in the SRH dugout
Slower bouncer going across Tilak, who manages to fetch it from outside off and work it to deep midwicket
Length ball angled across him, Tilak slaps it away to the off side sweeper's left for two
Goes for the wide yorker, but ends up pitching it outside of the tramline
Full outside off and Tilak drives this over mid-off for a one-bounce four. He has picked up the tempo after a subdued start
Tossed up full on middle, he drives it out to long-off
Punches a googly on off to cover
Another short-ish ball, Naman powers it down the ground to long-on
Wrong'un on a length around off, Tilak stays back and whips it out to long-on. That brings up the 100-run mark for Mumbai Indians
Tossed full but well wide of off stump
Long hop dispatched over deep midwicket! Tossed up across Tilak who rocks back and nails the pull
Starts with a length ball and Naman miscues a pull that falls in no-man's land towards long-on
That should get Tilak going! Length ball around middle angling down leg, Tilak swivels and uses the pace to get it over the fine leg boundary
Length ball outside off, Tilak looks to cut but gets an underedge to the keeper's right
Very full outside off, punched out wide of mid-off. This one was at 146.5kph
Brilliant pickup shot! Length ball angled down leg at 145kph, Naman uses the pace and helps it over the fine leg boundary
Fired full and down leg for a wide

Klaasen just gets a glove to it! Good keeping by him. This was a length ball going across Tilak who gloves it fine down the leg side. Klaasen throws himself at it but can't hold on but he has saved three runs there for sure
Full outside off at 145kph and seaming away as Tilak looks to go inside out but finds himself slashing at thin air
Length ball on middle and leg spins in, Tilak stays back and whips it out to deep midwicket
Pushed out to short third for a quick single. An over throw goes towards long-off allowing them to run a second
Sees Tilak giving charge and throws it wider. Tilak can only inside edge it onto the ground and back to the bowler
Shahbaz darts it in quicker and Naman drills it out through midwicket
Gorgeous inside-out four! Makes room leg-side and lofts this full delivery over cover
Tilak looks to go across the stumps and scoop behind. Ends up missing it as he gets nutmegged and the ball narrowly misses off stump
Slower ball, full around off, Tilak plays it out to deep point
Full on off, angled across Tilak, who punches it to cover
Length ball angled across Tilak, who pulls it down to mid-on

High in the air, no reprieve this time. Rohit has to walk back. Cummins gets the big wicket! Back of length delivery seams in slightly from outside off. Rohit is looking for the pull but gets a top edge that goes miles in the air. Abhishek Sharma has to take a few steps in from deep backward square and he makes no mistake as he catches it falling forward
Glorious! This is full around middle, Rohit just waits on it and whips it over midwicket
Full on middle and off, clipped wide of mid-on for a single

Dropped by Abdul Samad! Rohit miscues as he looks to go down the ground to a length ball that just grips in the surface. Goes high in the air, Samad is running back from mid-on and it bursts through his hands
Length ball, clipped to square leg off his pads. Naman Dhir had taken off for the single but is sent back and just about makes it to the crease safely
Rohit looks to slog away a full delivery outside off, the ball goes through under the bat
Length ball on the pads, he clips it through midwicket for a single

Kishan holes out at deep midwicket! Shahbaz tosses it up wider, Kishan goes for the slog sweep again and ends up not hitting it cleanly. The ball goes high but doesn't have the distance. Aiden Markram takes it backtracking near the boundary
Ishan Kishan doesn't mind! Tossed up in the slot on middle and off, Kishan gets down and slogs it 103m over the deep midwicket boundary
Yorker around leg, Kishan digs it out to long-on and that brings up the fifty-run partnership in three overs!
Pummelled down the ground! In the slot outside off and he lofts it straight over the bowler's head
Yorker outside off, Kishan tries to bring his bat down but is beaten
And another one! This one was in the slot and Kishan smokes it over cow corner. This was hit flatter and just clears the boundary rope wide of long-on
Gets all of that one! Length ball angled across Kishan again. He shifts weight onto his back foot and swings it over midwicket
Top edge goes for four! Length ball angled across Kishan, who loses shape as he looks to go big over the leg side. Thick edge goes high in the air but there is no deep third
Goes for a yorker around middle and off, Rohit moves leg-side and jams his bat down with the open face but can't clear short third
And now he skips down the track and hammers it over midwicket! Back-to-back sixes! This was on a full length outside leg, but Rohit made room and could swing it away
Length ball on middle and leg. Rohit just waits on it and flicks it behind square, helping it over the bundary
Length ball outside off, Kishan gets an inside edge onto his pad. The ball pops to the off side and they get a single
Low full toss, punched back by Kishan. Unadkat sticks a leg out and only ends up deflecting it past the stumps at the non-striker's end and to the long-on boundary. Kishan is off the mark
Length ball around middle and off rises sharply, Rohit drops it to his right and takes a quick single
Length ball angled across Kishan, he punches it to point
Length ball down leg, Kishan looks to heave it away but misses and it goes off his hips. Klaasen throws himself at it but can only deflect it fine for four leg byes
Length ball on leg at 133kph, swinging away. Kishan blocks
On a length, well outside off, Rohit cuts it away to deep point
And there we go! Rohit goes downtown, showing he means business here!. Full delivery outside off, Rohit frees his arms and muscles this down the ground
On a length outside off, hint of shape away, Rohit eases it to point
